english.title: Permit use of a motor vehicle seat belt fastening not maintained
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with a **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF BELT..) seat belt in accordance with regulation 47 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, when the seat belt buckle or other fastening was not

(A)_[so maintained that the belt could be readily fastened or unfastened]_
(B)_[kept free from any temporary or permanent obstruction]_
(C)_[readily accessible to a person sitting in the seat for which the belt was provided]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 48(4)(d) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) See Regulation 48(5) for exceptions. This offence does not apply to a disabled person's seat belt.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H3275 and H2660.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
